sentences.sentence: It was a dark and spooky night in the laboratory.
Young and ambitious Dr.Frankenstein was excited to create a new man.
Dr.Frankenstein felt extremely terrified by the sight of the monster.
Dr.Frankenstein felt a little shocked by the appearance of the monster.
Dr.Frankenstein felt so amazed that his monster had come to life.
Dr.Frankenstein was aware that the monster was really big and a little scary.
The really huge monster was bigger than any human.
Dr.Frankenstein was so surprised when the monster suddenly looked at him.
